description: Unofficial Madoka Kaname fan art from Puella Magi Madoka Magica, in her normal pink magical-girl outfit with a modest opaque high-neck underlayer and white tights. She ties a gift ribbon, displays a blunt miniature flower bow without arrows, turns with a paper flower and takes light directional steps and a small jump. Nine original peaceful animation states; no official affiliation.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
